# AI Expert

> AI automation services in Auckland, New Zealand. AI Expert, run by Nimish Rangani, builds n8n and LLM workflows for outreach, content production and internal operations, and works remotely with clients elsewhere.

## About
- Nimish Rangani is an AI automation engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand, with 7+ years in enterprise IT (Bosch, Seqirus, Sigma Healthcare).
- Education: Master of ICT (La Trobe University), Bachelor of IT (University of Mumbai). Certified Associate in Software Testing (CAST).
- Tools: n8n, Claude API and other LLMs, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Modal, Remotion, FLUX, Whisper, edge-tts.

## Services
- Outreach with reply triage: n8n send and follow-up workflows, LLM reply classification, PostgreSQL log.
- Content pipeline: LLM scripting, voiceover, Remotion video or FLUX and Whisper on Modal, automatic publishing.
- Custom AI workflow: scoped build around a client's existing tools using the Claude API and n8n.
- Price is fixed after a 30-minute call and a written scope. See pricing below.

## Pricing (NZD, GST added where it applies)
- Custom AI workflow: from NZ$1,500
- Outreach with reply triage: from NZ$2,500
- Content pipeline: from NZ$3,000
- Care plan: from NZ$300 per month
- Ad-hoc changes: NZ$120 per hour
- Full details: https://aiexpert.qd.je/pricing/

## Case studies (all built and run by Nimish Rangani)
- Outreach that sorts its own replies: live for two businesses, LLM classifies replies as interested, not interested or referral, no manual triage.
- A video factory with no operator: LLM script, edge-tts voiceover, Remotion render, auto-publish; batches of 100+ videos per run.
- GPU work without a GPU server: FLUX image generation and Whisper captions on Modal, orchestrated by n8n, cross-posted automatically.
- A live AI product: Claude API content analysis with Supabase auth, PostgreSQL and TypeScript frontend, serving real users.
